children: B.AI said on August 31 that total token throughput across its platform has surpassed 5.74 trillion during its free access event for frontier models. According to ChainCatcher, the platform is offering several models for free, including GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, Tencent Hy3, and Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5.
The company said the models cover use cases including code generation, long-text processing, multimodal visual understanding, and Agent workflow deployment.

title: B.AI Says Platform Token Throughput Tops 5.74 Trillion During Free Model Access Event
